## kram-p16-v16 — argument map

In emitted thing-share outside, in extreme taste-bliss, You resort by rush to redness-made. Then red goddess, Yours in all things — make me, by red-drinking-order-joined conclave, past-loathing.

### Open
- ghṛṇā double sense (loathing/compassion) held; nanu as prayer-particle.
